Use @Image1 as the starting frame.
Smooth gentle push-in from medium wide to a closer heroic frame on @Image2 as she stands leaning both elbows on the white railing. She faces fully into the ocean breeze with eyes closed a beat, wind whipping her hair across her shoulders and shirt. Then she opens her eyes, turns her face slightly toward the wind, and lifts a fingertip lightly to the corner of her mouth to check the coral colour still holds. Small private smile forms. Fabric of the white linen flutters, distant waves roll and foam white against the shore.

steady ocean wind and rolling surf, distant beach ambience under bright daylight. fabric of linen shirt fluttering in the breeze, soft wind across hair and face.

Single continuous shot, no cuts. Avoid jitter and bent limbs.
